description: React component for selecting, adding, and removing roadmaps within a team, including modals for creating and customizing roadmaps, and handling asynchronous data fetching and updates.

methods.name: loadAllRoadmaps
methods.description: Fetches all roadmaps from the server, filters and sorts them, then updates state.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Deletes a roadmap resource from the team via API call and updates state.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of a roadmap resource, calls deleteResource.

methods.name: addTeamResource
methods.description: Adds a new roadmap resource to the team via API call and updates state.

methods.name: handleCustomRoadmapCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a custom roadmap, reloads roadmaps, and adds the new one.
